final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT t.healtheval AS he, SUM(s.scancount) AS total_scans, AVG(CAST(s.gbsize AS REAL) / s.spanmin) AS avg_ratio FROM scans s JOIN sites t ON t.zoneregistry = s.zoneref WHERE s.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND s.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY t.healtheval), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall FROM s1) SELECT s1.he, s1.total_scans, s1.avg_ratio, s1.avg_ratio - s2.overall AS diff FROM s1 JOIN s2 WHERE s2.overall IS NOT NULL
